other_failure_modes.description: Computing global statistics (like frequency counts or target/group cardinalities) on the combined train and test datasets before splitting them back. This leaks information about the test distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a solid baseline using LightGBM with 5-fold cross-validation and extracts useful date and interaction features. However, the solution suffers from critical data leakage by calculating categorical frequency mappings on the combined train/test dataset. Furthermore, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the data by using a randomized CV split, lacks explicit data cleaning, and relies solely on a single evaluation metric.
